reacoes.ajuda: Moderation picks up to 6 emojis for reactions on posts here. Nobody sees who reacted: only the total for each emoji, and only from 3 up.
reacoes.voltou: The community is back to the default list.
reacoes.sairam: Reactions with an emoji that leaves the list stop showing and come back if it returns.

erros.emoji: Emojis only, no letters, numbers or the obscene gesture.

pasta.publica: This folder is public: it shows as a collection on your profile.
pasta.ajuda: Only open posts go into the collection. Restricted ones (followers, community, núcleo or staff) stay only here, and whoever reads the collection only sees what they could already see.
pasta.ficouFora: Some posts in this folder are restricted and stayed only here.
pasta.semHandle: To have a public collection, first choose your @ on your profile.
pasta.erro: Could not change it. Try again.

traducao.noAparelho: Translated on this device: the text did not leave it.
traducao.noServidor: Translated by Alumia's server: the text went to our server, not to third parties.
traducao.baixarAjuda: The first time, the browser downloads the translation model from its own maker. The post text does not leave the device.
traducao.leve: In light mode, on-device translation is off.

imagem.restrito: Only posts open to the internet become images.
imagem.ajuda: The image is made here on the device and carries Alumia's address and @institutoluciaorg.
